## data.loading

```{r}
source("./00_ColorSetting.R")
seur <- readRDS("./RData/seur.rds")
sce_inf <- readRDS("./RData/01_sce_inf.rds")
identical(rownames(sce_inf), colnames(seur))
sce_inf$IFNG <- seur@assays$RNA@data["IFNG", ]
seur@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings <- as.matrix(sce_inf[, c("UMAP1_cl", "UMAP2_cl")])
colnames(seur@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
Idents(seur) <- sce_inf$cell_lineages
cd8t_inf <- readRDS("./RData/03_cd8t_inf_renew.rds")
```

### Fig.3A

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
density_plot <- function(sce_inf = sce_inf,
                         geneCut = 0, 
                         x = "UMAP_1",
                         y = "UMAP_2",
                         h = c(1, 1),
                         n = 150){
    p <- sce_inf %>%
        ggplot(aes_string(x = x, y = y)) +
        geom_point(alpha = .5, size = .2, color = "grey80") 
    options(repr.plot.width = 4.5, repr.plot.height = 4)
    tmp <- dplyr::filter(sce_inf, IFNG > geneCut)
    p <- p + stat_density_2d(aes(fill = ..level..), 
                    alpha = .5, geom = "polygon", 
                    data = tmp, h = h,
                    n = n)+
              scale_fill_distiller(palette = "OrRd") +
              ggtitle("IFNG+ density")
    return(p)
}
density_plot(sce_inf = sce_inf,
             
             geneCut = 0, h = c(1, 1))
```

### Fig.3B

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=4}
sce_inf$IFNG_bin <- ifelse(sce_inf$IFNG > 0, "IFNG>0", "IFNG=0")
sce_inf$IFNG_bin <- factor(sce_inf$IFNG_bin, levels = c("IFNG>0", "IFNG=0"))
sce_inf %>% dplyr::filter(cell_lineages != "Epithelial.cells") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = IFNG_bin, fill = cell_lineages)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(~AIT) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_lineages_colors) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  RotatedAxis()
```



### Fig.3C

```{r}
norm <- seur@assays$RNA$data
cd8t_clusters <- c("CD8T_CCL4L2",
                   "CD8T_HAVCR2",
                   "CD8T_HSPA1A",
                   "CD8T_MKI67",
                   "CD8T_ISG15",
                   "CD8T_MT1X",
                   "CD8T_FGFBP2",
                   "CD8T_TRAF3IP3",
                   "CD8T_KLRC3",
                   "CD8T_LEF1",
                   "CD8T_CXCL13",
                   "CD8T_CCR7", 
                   "CD8T_FN1")
clusters_SID_ob <- as.matrix(table(cd8t_inf$sampleType_AIT, cd8t_inf$clusters_anno))
cellsum <- table(cd8t_inf$clusters_anno)
SIDsum <- table(cd8t_inf$sampleType_AIT)
clusters_SID_exp <- matrix(rep(cellsum, length(SIDsum)),nrow = length(SIDsum), byrow = TRUE)*matrix(rep(SIDsum, length(cellsum)),nrow = length(SIDsum), byrow = FALSE)/nrow(cd8t_inf)
Ro_e <- t(clusters_SID_ob/clusters_SID_exp)
range01 <- function(x, ...){(x - min(x, ...)) / (max(x, ...) - min(x, ...))}

Ro_e_01 <- t(apply(Ro_e, 1, range01))

###Ro/e
bk <- c(seq(0, 1, by=0.01),seq(1.01,1.99,by=0.01))
options(repr.plot.width = 10, repr.plot.height = 3)
t(Ro_e[cd8t_clusters, ]) %>%
  pheatmap::pheatmap(cluster_rows = FALSE,
                     cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     scale = "none",
                     color = c(colorRampPalette(colors = c(sampleType_colors[1],"white"))(length(bk)/2),
                               colorRampPalette(colors = c("white",sampleType_colors[2]))(length(bk)/2)),                     
                     breaks = bk,
                     border_color = NA, 
                     display_numbers = T,
                     annotation_legend = FALSE,
                     gaps_col = c(5),
                     number_color = "grey20", 
                     fontsize_number = 10,
                     width =  8, height = 3)

genes <- read.table("./RData/03_CD8T_markerss.txt", sep = "\t")
gene_scales <- as.data.frame(scale(t(as.matrix(norm[rev(genes$V1), rownames(cd8t_inf)]))))
gene_scales_quant <- aggregate(gene_scales, by = list(cd8t_inf$clusters_anno), 
                               FUN = function(x) quantile(x, .8))
rownames(gene_scales_quant) <- gene_scales_quant$Group.1
gene_scales_quant <- t(gene_scales_quant[, -1])
clusters_anno <- data.frame(clusters_anno = cd8t_clusters)
rownames(clusters_anno) <- clusters_anno$clusters_anno


options(repr.plot.width = 10, repr.plot.height = 8)
pheatmap(gene_scales_quant[rev(rownames(gene_scales_quant)), cd8t_clusters],
                   scale = "row",
                   cluster_rows = F, 
                   cluster_cols = F,
                   color = colorRampPalette(c(sampleType_colors[1], "white", sampleType_colors[2]))(100),
              legend_breaks=seq(-1, 0, 1),
              breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 100),
               border_color = "black",
         width = 7, height = 7
                   )
```


### Fig.3D

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
aa <- c("CD8T_CCL4L2","CD8T_HAVCR2", "CD8T_HSPA1A","CD8T_MKI67","CD8T_ISG15")
cd8t_inf$IFNGcluster <- ifelse(cd8t_inf$clusters_anno %in% aa,
                               "IFNG+cluster", "IFNG-cluster")
usecol <- sampleType_colors
names(usecol) <- c("IFNG-cluster", "IFNG+cluster")
cd8t_inf %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sampleType_AIT, fill = IFNGcluster)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = usecol) +
  theme_cowplot() + 
  RotatedAxis()
```

### Fig.3E-3G:Experimemt

### Fig.3H

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
TCRcd8 <-  subset(cd8t_inf, TCR_BCR_detected == "TCR_paired" & is.na(special_cells))
TCRcd8$cloneID <- TCRcd8$cdr3_paired_seq
clonDat <- table(TCRcd8$cloneID) %>% as.data.frame()
clonDat <- table(clonDat$Freq) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(clonDat) <- c("Clone", "Freq")
uniqC <- clonDat[clonDat$Clone==1, ]$Freq # mono
totolC <- length(unique(TCRcd8$cloneID))
clonDat$Clone <- as.numeric(clonDat$Clone)
ggplot(clonDat, aes(x = log2(Clone), y = log2(Freq))) + 
  geom_point(size = 3, color = sampleType_AIT_col[2]) + 
  xlab("log2(clone size)") + 
  ylab("log2(clone number)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggtitle(paste0("Total ", totolC," CD8T cell clones"))
```

### Fig.3I

```{r}
cd8t_paired_inf <- subset(cd8t_inf, 
                          TCR_BCR_detected == "TCR_paired" & is.na(special_cells))

cd8t_paired_sampleType_inf_list <- split(cd8t_paired_inf, f = cd8t_paired_inf$sampleType)

shared_clones <- unique(intersect(cd8t_paired_sampleType_inf_list[[1]]$cdr3_paired_seq, 
                                  cd8t_paired_sampleType_inf_list[[2]]$cdr3_paired_seq))
cd8t_inf$cloneType <- ifelse(cd8t_inf$cdr3_paired_seq %in% shared_clones, "shared", 
                             ifelse(is.na(cd8t_inf$expanded_clones), NA, "individual"))

options(repr.plot.width = 8, repr.plot.height = 4)
cd8t_inf %>% 
  subset(!is.na(IFNG_clones)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = IFNG_clones, fill = cloneType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TCRshare) +
  facet_grid(~sampleType_AIT) 
```


```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
tmp <- cd8t_inf %>%  subset(!is.na(IFNG_clones))
table(tmp$cloneType, tmp$IFNG_clones, tmp$sampleType_AIT)  %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = Freq, fill = Var1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
  facet_wrap(Var2 ~ Var3, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TCRshare) 
```


### Fig.3J

```{r}
cd8t_inf$sampleType_AIT <- factor(cd8t_inf$sampleType_AIT, 
                                 levels = c("AIT-NAT", "AIT+NAT", "AIT-PTC","AIT+PTC"))
pdat <- cd8t_inf %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(IFNG_clones)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(IFNG_clones == "yes")
sv40order <- CalculatePro(pdat, ID = "SID", Cluster = "SV40_OT1",
                          usecol = c("sampleType_AIT")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(SV40_OT1 == "SV40")
sv40order <- dplyr::group_by(sv40order, sampleType_AIT) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent),.by_group = TRUE)
cd8t_inf$SID <- factor(cd8t_inf$SID, levels = sv40order$SID)
cd8t_inf %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(IFNG_clones)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(IFNG_clones == "yes") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SID , fill = SV40_OT1)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = sv.ot_col) +
  facet_grid(~sampleType_AIT,scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```



```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
tmp <- cd8t_inf %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(IFNG_clones)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(IFNG_clones == "yes") 
bystander <- as.data.frame(prop.table(table(tmp$SID, tmp$SV40_OT1), 1))
head(bystander)
bystander$sampleType_AIT <- cd8t_inf[match(bystander$Var1, cd8t_inf$SID), "sampleType_AIT"]
bystander$sampleType_AIT <- factor(bystander$sampleType_AIT, levels = c("AIT-NAT", "AIT+NAT", "AIT-PTC","AIT+PTC"))
bystander %>% subset(Var2 == "OT1") %>%
  ggboxplot(x = "sampleType_AIT", y = "Freq", fill = "sampleType_AIT", ylab = "OT1 bystander") + scale_fill_manual(values = sampleType_AIT_col) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("AIT-NAT","AIT+NAT"),
                                        c("AIT-PTC","AIT+PTC")),
                     method = "wilcox") + NoLegend()
```
